title: what's the actual minimum sleep before I get dumber

messages.content: how much sleep do i really need before i get dumber? 5 hrs okay? need max productivity!!!

Research suggests the average adult needs 7-9 hours of sleep per night for optimal cognitive function. Consistently getting less than 7 hours has been linked to declines in attention, memory, and decision-making skills. While it's possible to function on 5 hours occasionally, you may find your productivity and creativity decreasing over time. Prioritizing sleep could help ensure you're at your best for those Mars plans!
